frame_step_note: row j of these arrays is control step j, i.e. video frame j+1, and frame[j] says so; pad_forcen and pad_forcen_frame have one row per video frame starting at frame 0, the reset observation, which is why they hold one more row than this table

panel.force_columns_note: l_inner/l_outer/r_inner/r_outer are columns 12/13/14/15 of the env's 18-wide observation.force, raw newtons; the left pair minus force_calib_v1's zero-load reference is proprio14 columns 11/12, which is what the model conditioned on. The trace itself is in the steps npz as pad_forcen, one row per video frame.
notes: encoded by cv2/mp4v: the pod imageio resolves to PyAV, whose write() rejects the compositor's quality= kwarg; layout and synchronisation verified, bitstream (libx264/yuv420p) parity not

report_scope: 在可追溯重建 normalizer 条件下的 40k 诊断结果
trajectory_basis: steps.npz row j is control step j == video frame j+1; only the executed first replan rows are here; the 32-row prediction lives in actions.npz stacked per chunk and is never used as the executed trajectory
